core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Husain corresponds to the Arabic form حسين (Arabic root ح س ن (ḥ-s-n); حُسَيْن (Ḥusayn)). Its core sense is husayn; diminutive of hasan. Husain is Arabic حُسَيْن (Ḥusayn), the diminutive of حَسَن (Ḥasan), from the root ح س ن (ḥ-s-n); it is a well-documented male given name borne by Husayn ibn Ali, grandson of the Prophet Muhammad. The source gloss 'Graceful, Generous' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as husayn, husein, hussain and hussein.

urdu.name: حسین
